summary: 전시즌 순위와 선수단 추정 시장가치는 실험 후보입니다. 성능 향상은 아직 입증하지 않았습니다. Transfermarkt 과거 기준일 열이 존재하지만 전체 학습기간 수집은 미완료이며 현재 값의 과거 대입은 금지합니다.

evidence.description: Official-domain search index inspected: community-based estimated player market values; not actual transfer fees; age, potential and performance included; complete league updates generally twice yearly. Direct .com equivalent returned HTTP 403.

Official-domain indexed dated table inspected. Separate historical value/roster-size and current-value/current-roster columns, explicit 01.07.2023 reference date. No direct live extraction was performed.

Official-domain search index confirms LaLiga date-selector table exists. Search fragment is insufficient for complete historical cohort or publication-time validation; date is after some opening fixtures, so not a universal preseason cutoff.
Official-domain indexed 2022/23 table inspected; Barcelona first 88 points, Real Madrid second 78 points. This is coverage evidence/sample, not collection of full tables.
Official-domain indexed 2022/23 table sample inspected: Manchester City first 89 points and Arsenal second 84 points.
Existing local structured records read: four teams, all 2026-06-01 valuation date, EUR, SQUAD scope, retained source/observation date.
Existing provider-text cache read: historical cutoff selector and historical/current columns; corroborates stored EPL records. No new remote fetch or block bypass.
Existing provider-text cache read: corroborates stored LaLiga market-value records.
Local header and season coverage inspected. 40 rows each 2023/24 through 2026/27; no 2022/23. points_definition explicitly excludes official point deductions.

verified_facts.claim: Transfermarkt market value is an estimated player valuation, and the squad total aggregates players; it is not club enterprise/equity valuation or an actual transfer fee.
verified_facts.basis: Official definition plus squad size/total market value table labels.
verified_facts.qualification: Enterprise-value distinction follows from the valuation object being players; no club financial valuation was collected.

verified_facts.claim: Official date-selector market-value tables expose past reference-date value separately from current value.
verified_facts.basis: Official indexed 2023-07-01 EPL table and local dated provider caches.

verified_facts.claim: An ordinary saison_id historical season page is not proof of a pre-match valuation snapshot.
verified_facts.basis: Season selection and explicit stichtag dated valuation are different controls; ordinary season page lacks verified per-match valuation timestamp.

verified_facts.claim: Only four dated structured market-value records already exist locally, all 2026-06-01.
verified_facts.basis: Read dated_market_values.json. The provider-text caches may contain additional rows, but their full parsing/mapping was not performed in this task.

indexed_historical_sample.precision: Rounded provider display; not exact underlying sum.
indexed_historical_sample.reason: Only exploratory sample. Historical cohort completeness, value publication timing and current-column contamination not independently verified.

proposed_features_not_implemented_here.meaning: Previous completed season finishing position, scaled by that division's number of clubs.
proposed_features_not_implemented_here.requirement: Keep league tier, season and source; do not treat second-division rank as first-division rank.

proposed_features_not_implemented_here.meaning: Explicit missing-rank indicator; unknown rank must not become zero or league champion.
Separate promoted status from absent dataset history; a returning established club can also be missing from local history.
Home/away difference in logarithm of historical squad value; hypothetical model design, not proven benefit.
proposed_features_not_implemented_here.requirement: Same currency and verified valuation date at or before prediction cutoff; no forward-fill from future dates.

proposed_features_not_implemented_here.meaning: Missing-value flag and elapsed days since valid valuation; roster changes reduce reliability.
proposed_features_not_implemented_here.requirement: Imputation learned on training period only; no current value replacement.

inferences_and_limits: Previous rank and market value may provide a preseason strength prior, particularly for sparse current-season records, but overlapping existing previous-season performance may yield little additional information.
Valuation also reflects age and future potential; it is an imperfect proxy for current match strength.

Increasing the displayed favorite win probability is not the same as improving prediction quality. Compare chronological holdout log loss, Brier score and calibration, as well as accuracy, against unchanged baseline.

A historical valuation date alone does not prove when each underlying valuation was first published or whether an archived reconstruction was revised. Preserve valuation_date, observed_at and publication/effective timestamp when available; mark unknowns.
A dated league table may use current competition membership. Check all season participants and promoted/relegated clubs explicitly rather than assuming twenty historical clubs are covered.

issues.detail: Direct .com definition and EPL/LaLiga 2023 season pages returned HTTP 403; Arsenal analysis URL was inaccessible. No alternate transport or access-control bypass attempted.
No complete mapped historical market-value collection for all EPL/LaLiga clubs and 2023/24–2026/27 pre-match cutoffs.
2022/23 previous-season rank coverage is absent from current source-unified season CSV; needed for earliest 2023/24 model inputs.

Official final rank differs potentially from raw 3/1/0 result points because of deductions and tie-break rules. Understat-derived sorting must be labeled a calculated performance rank unless official final positions are separately verified.
No model training or performance comparison executed by this research agent; benefit remains a hypothesis.
Account/private access rights, historical publication timestamps and full-cohort roster availability were not verified.
